x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/submittal_responses?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

the older `GET /submittal_responses` endpoint.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"submittal_response\":{\"name\":\"Approved\",\"considered\":\"approved\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/submittal_responses", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
